Name: (CP) Sequential Dateables' Heart Events (SDHE)
Author: Enri0425
Description:
This mod edits each vanilla bachelor/bachelorette's heart events so that they're forced to happen in order.
For example, with this mod you won't be able to see Shane's 6th heart event before seeing his 2nd and 4th one.
If you're like me, who is bothered by seeing Alex's 4th heart event before his 2nd one since it can only happen in Summer, this mod is for you!
And speaking of Alex, if you also don't like how his 2nd and 8th heart event can only occur during Summer, I added an option through Generic Mod Config Tool to make them happen in other seasons as well, you just need to check the config "Alex Accessible Heart Event", since by default it's not active.
These specific edits are the same from my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33113]Accessible Alex Heart Events [/url]mod, which is [b]not needed[/b] for the edits to work, but I'd advise you to still check it out if you need more information.
Also, you can use Generic Mod Config Tool to turn off which characters you don't want their heart events to be played in order, just uncheck their respective config.
This mod does [b]not[/b] change the dating/marriage mechanics, you can still date/marry any marriage candidate even when you haven't seen all their heart events, you only need the right amount of friendship points.
Also I only edited the conditions of the pre-marriage heart events, so you will still be able to see their 14th heart event even if you haven't seen their previous ones.
WARNING: This mod may not work with others that alter the marriage candidates' heart events.
You need SMAPI, Content Patcher and Generic Mod Config Tool for this mod to work.
